label: Shown sub-region
summary: The sub-region of a situation that the sub-region window is showing.
details: Vanilla's sub-region window sets it as the context of its whole content, so everything inside reads from that sub-region, for example its bazaar building (SituationSubRegion.GetBazaarBuilding). The game documents no return type.

label: Sub-region window itself
summary: A function on the situation sub-region window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types (for example Character.Self passed as an argument); those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access situation type itself
summary: A function on a situation type that, going by its name, hands back the situation type itself.
details: A situation type is the definition a situation is made from (for example the dynastic cycle). Vanilla never names this function on it; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Situation type description
summary: The description text of a situation type.
details: Vanilla shows it as the description text of the situation type's tooltip, in the tooltip's body.

label: Group type
summary: A function on a situation type that, going by its name, returns a group type belonging to it.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. The same name on doctrine groups and activity groups returns their group type; that is only a hint. Which group a situation type has (a participant group or something else) the input does not show. The game documents no return type.

label: Situation type icon
summary: Going by its name, the icon of a situation type.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; GetIcon on other things (DLCs, inspiration types) gives a texture for the interface, which is only a hint. See also HasIcon, which going by its name tells whether the type has one. The game documents no return type.

label: Situation type illustration
summary: Going by its name, the illustration picture of a situation type.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; GetIllustration on domicile types gives a picture for the interface, which is only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Situation type name
summary: The name of a situation type.
details: Vanilla's situation trigger texts use it: "The situation is (not) [type name]".

label: Name without tooltip
summary: The name of a situation type as plain text, without a tooltip attached to it.
details: Vanilla uses it as the title of the situation type's own tooltip. Going by its name, it is the variant of GetName that carries no tooltip of its own.

label: Participant group types
summary: Going by its name and its uses, the list of participant group types a situation type defines.
details: Vanilla reaches this list from a phase's parent situation type and from a situation's type, and feeds it to lists in the Christian church and Silk Road windows. What a participant group is the input does not say. The game documents no return type.

label: Phase type by key
summary: One phase type of a situation type, picked by the key given in brackets.
details: Vanilla's debug texts write GetSituationType('dynastic_cycle').GetPhaseType('situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_stability').GetName to show a phase's name. Those lines reach a situation type through GetSituationType, so they very likely belong to this function, but they are listed only as same-name uses. The game documents no return type.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: the phase's key in quotes, for example 'situation_dynastic_cycle_phase_stability'

label: Phases
summary: Going by its name and its uses, the list of phases a situation type can go through.
details: Vanilla reaches it from the situation's type (Situation.GetType.GetPhases) and lists the result in the Christian church and Silk Road windows. The game documents no return type.

label: Has icon
summary: Going by its name, whether the situation type has an icon.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; HasIcon on laws and situation phase types decides in tooltips whether an icon is shown, which is only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Tooltip group focused
summary: Going by its name, whether the situation type's tooltips are focused on a group (a yes or no).
details: Vanilla's dynastic cycle window reaches it from a phase's parent situation type and shows one of two layouts depending on it. What exactly decides the value, and what the two layouts show, the input does not say.

label: Situation type itself
summary: The situation type itself, for passing it on to another function.
details: Vanilla passes it to GetSituationOfType( SituationType.Self ) to reach the running situation of this type, in the dynastic cycle and natural disaster windows and in the situation type tooltip. The game documents no return type.

label: Uses flat phase icons
summary: Whether the situation type shows its phases with flat icons (a yes or no).
details: Vanilla's Great Steppe window and a tooltip reach it from a situation's type and show one of two things depending on it, going by its name flat icons or the other style.

label: Participant list
summary: The list of participating characters in the situation window, as an object the window can toggle and select a group on.
details: Vanilla toggles it with a button (AccessParticipantCharacterList.Toggle), uses it as a context, and in the dynastic cycle window selects the player's own top participant group on it when the window opens (SetSelectedParticipantGroup). It returns a SituationParticipantCharacterList.

label: Access situation window itself
summary: A function on the situation window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Clear selected future phase
summary: Clears the future phase selected in the situation window.
details: Vanilla's dynastic cycle window calls it when the window opens and from a button. It returns nothing; it only changes what the window has selected. See SetSelectedFuturePhaseType for selecting one.

label: Close situation window
summary: Closes the situation window.
details: Vanilla puts it on the close buttons of the situation window, its debug variant and the dynastic cycle window. It returns nothing.

label: Catalysts of selected phase
summary: The list of catalysts for the phase selected in the situation window.
details: Vanilla's situation window uses it as a list and shows another element instead when the list is empty. What a catalyst is the input does not say. The game documents no return type.

label: Current history page
summary: The entries of the history page the situation window is showing.
details: Vanilla's dynastic cycle window lists these history entries and shows a placeholder when the page is empty. Turn the pages with NextHistoryPage and PreviousHistoryPage. The game documents no return type.

label: Ending decisions
summary: Going by its name, the list of decisions that can end the situation.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. StruggleWindow has a function of the same name whose list size decides what the struggle window shows; that is only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: History page count
summary: The number of history pages in the situation window.
details: Vanilla's dynastic cycle window shows it as the second number of a page counter such as "2 / 5", with GetHistoryPageUIIndex as the first.

label: History page number
summary: The number of the history page the situation window shows, counted from 1 for display.
details: Vanilla's dynastic cycle window shows it as the first number of the page counter and allows the previous-page button only while it is above 1.

label: Participation header
summary: The header text of the participation part of the situation window.
details: Vanilla shows it as a heading in the situation window and in the natural disaster window. What the text says depends on the situation; the input does not show it.

label: Phase progress bar
summary: The progress bar showing how far the phases of the given sub-region have advanced.
details: Vanilla passes the sub-region (SituationSubRegion.Self) and uses the result as the context of a bar in the situation and natural disaster windows. That it is a multi-part bar rests on its name. The game documents no return type.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The sub-region whose progress is shown.
fields.values: a situation sub-region, such as SituationSubRegion.Self

label: Selected future phase
summary: Going by its name, the future phase selected in the situation window.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; the dynastic cycle window uses SituationDynasticCycleWindow.GetSelectedFuturePhase instead, which is only a hint. GetSelectedFuturePhaseType gives the selected phase's type. The game documents no return type.

label: Selected future phase type
summary: The type of the future phase the player has selected in the situation window, if any.
details: Vanilla checks whether it is valid to show either the selected phase or the default view, and compares it with each listed future phase to mark the selected button as pressed. It is set by SetSelectedFuturePhaseType and emptied by ClearSelectedFuturePhaseType. The game documents no return type.

label: Selected or current phase
summary: The phase type selected in the situation window, or the current phase when none is selected.
details: Vanilla's dynastic cycle window shows this phase, its effects for each participant group, and turns the cycle's wheel to it. That it falls back to the current phase rests on its name. The game documents no return type.

label: Selected or leading future phase
summary: The future phase type selected in the situation window, or else the future phase that is currently in the lead.
details: Vanilla's situation window shows this phase's icon and its named modifier sets. The fallback to the leading future phase rests on its name. The game documents no return type.

label: Selected sub-region
summary: The sub-region of the situation that is selected in the situation window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the context for the sub-region details, and reaches its current phase through it (GetSelectedSubRegion.GetCurrentPhase). It is chosen with SetSelectedSubRegion. It returns a SituationSubRegion.

label: Situation
summary: The situation the situation window is showing.
details: Vanilla uses it as the context of the window and reads from it, for example the number of participating characters (warlords) in a dynastic cycle tooltip. It returns a Situation.

label: Situation decisions
summary: The list of decisions shown for the situation in the situation window.
details: Vanilla's dynastic cycle window lists them, one decision button each. Which decisions belong to a situation the input does not show. The game documents no return type.

label: Has next history page
summary: Whether there is another history page after the one the situation window shows.
details: Vanilla's dynastic cycle window allows the next-page button only while this is true.

label: Has possible ending decision
summary: Going by its name, whether any decision that ends the situation is possible now.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Struggle and StruggleWindow have functions of the same name that decide whether ending-decision buttons are shown; that is only a hint.

label: Has possible situation decision
summary: Going by its name, whether any of the situation's decisions is possible now.
details: Vanilla does not use this name anywhere, so nothing more can be said. Compare GetSituationDecisions, which lists the situation's decisions.

label: Is participant
summary: Going by its name, whether someone takes part in the situation shown in the window.
details: It takes no argument, so it does not check a given character; who is checked rests on its name. Vanilla never names it on this type; Activity.IsParticipant, which takes a character, is a different type and only a hint.

label: Next history page
summary: Turns the situation window's history to the next page.
details: Vanilla's dynastic cycle window calls it from the next-page button, which is enabled only while HasNextHistoryPage is true. It returns nothing.

label: Decision click
summary: Handles a click on one of the situation's decisions in the situation window.
details: Vanilla's dynastic cycle window calls it from each decision button with the decision (Decision.Self). What happens next, for example opening the decision, the input does not show. It returns nothing.

label: Previous history page
summary: Turns the situation window's history back to the previous page.
details: Vanilla's dynastic cycle window calls it from the previous-page button, which is enabled only while the page number is above 1. It returns nothing.

label: Situation window itself
summary: A function on the situation window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types; those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Select future phase
summary: Selects the given future phase type in the situation window, so the window shows its details.
details: Vanilla calls it when a future phase button is clicked in the dynastic cycle window and the situation debug window. Read the choice with GetSelectedFuturePhaseType; undo it with ClearSelectedFuturePhaseType. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a situation phase type, such as FutureSituationPhase.GetType.Self

label: Select sub-region
summary: Selects the given sub-region of the situation in the situation window.
details: Vanilla calls it when a sub-region is clicked in the situation window and its debug variant. Read the choice with GetSelectedSubRegion. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a situation sub-region, such as SituationSubRegion.Self

label: Toggle future phase
summary: Selects the given future phase type in the situation window, or removes the selection when that phase is already selected.
details: Vanilla's situation window calls it when a future phase button is clicked. The deselecting on a second click rests on its name (toggle); SetSelectedFuturePhaseType only selects. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The phase type to select or deselect.
fields.values: a situation phase type, such as FutureSituationPhase.GetType.Self

label: Access skill entry itself
summary: A function on a skill entry of the interface that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: A skill item is one skill as shown in a window. Vanilla never names this function on it; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Skill icon frame
summary: Going by its name and its use, the frame number that picks the picture of the skill's icon.
details: Vanilla sets it as the frame of icons in the character window, the council task interaction and the tax collector window. That the icons come from one picture strip rests on how frames are used, not on the input.

label: Skill name
summary: The name of the skill, as text.
details: Vanilla uses it inside sentences, for example "This option is available because of your [skill name] skill" in events and in culture innovation tooltips, and as the tooltip of a skill icon.

label: Skill
summary: A whole number about the skill entry; going by its name, the skill it stands for or its level.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Character.GetSkill( 'prowess' ) in other texts gives a character's skill level, which is only a hint. Compare GetValue, which vanilla uses to show the skill's value.

label: Skill breakdown
summary: A text listing where the skill's value comes from (base value, traits, modifiers and so on).
details: Vanilla shows it at the top of the skill tooltip in the character window, followed by the skill's effects, and as the tooltip of skills in the council window. That it lists the sources of the value rests on its name (breakdown).

label: Skill effects
summary: A text describing the effects of the skill.
details: Vanilla shows it in the skill tooltip of the character window under the heading "Effects:". What it lists the input does not show.

label: Skill value
summary: The value (level) of the skill, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it as the number next to a skill in the character window.

label: Is focus skill
summary: Going by its name, whether this skill is a focus skill.
details: Vanilla does not use this name anywhere, so this rests on its name alone; what makes a skill a focus skill is not known.

label: Is important skill
summary: Going by its name, whether this skill counts as important.
details: Vanilla does not use this name anywhere, so what makes a skill important, and where, is not known.

label: Skill entry itself
summary: A function on a skill entry of the interface that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types; those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access scheme group itself
summary: A function on a skill's group of schemes that, going by its name, hands back the group itself.
details: Vanilla's intrigue window lists schemes per SkillSchemeGroup. Vanilla never names this function on such a group; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Scheme limit
summary: How many schemes of this skill's group can run at the same time.
details: Vanilla shows it as the limit in a counter such as "1/2" and in the tooltip "I can manage [limit] [skill] Schemes at a time" in the scheme window.

label: Running schemes
summary: How many schemes of this skill's group are running now.
details: Vanilla shows it as the first number of the scheme counter, next to the limit from GetMaxNumberOfSchemes.

label: Schemes
summary: The list of schemes in this skill's group.
details: Vanilla's intrigue window lists them, shown only while HasSchemes is true. The game documents no return type.

label: Scheme group name
summary: The name of this group of schemes, used inside sentences.
details: Vanilla uses it in the text "No [name] scheme in progress. Start one by interacting with another Character" in the scheme window.

label: Has schemes
summary: Whether this skill's group has any schemes in it.
details: Vanilla's intrigue window shows the list of schemes only while this is true.

label: Scheme group itself
summary: A function on a skill's group of schemes that, going by its name, hands back the group itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types; those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access skin editor itself
summary: A function of the engine's internal skin editor that, going by its name, hands back the editor itself.
details: The game files it under the engine's internal interface functions; vanilla never names it. PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents nothing more.

label: Skin editor itself
summary: A function of the engine's internal skin editor that, going by its name, hands back the editor itself.
details: The game files it under the engine's internal interface functions; vanilla never names it. Self after other types is only a hint. The game documents nothing more.

label: Range pattern
summary: The pattern set up for one entry of the map editor's smart material brush.
details: The smart material brush is an engine map editing tool that paints terrain materials by a pattern. Vanilla shows this pattern's setup (its type, curve, settings and material mix) for each entry, and passes it to the pictures of the pattern type and curve. The game documents no return type.

label: Entry itself
summary: This smart brush entry itself, to hand to an action of the painting tool.
details: Vanilla passes it to the actions that toggle visual debugging, move the entry up or down and delete it. Self gives the same for reading. The game documents no return type.

label: Entry name
summary: The name of a smart brush pattern entry.
details: Vanilla shows it in an editable box whose tooltip says the name is free to choose and need not be unique; SmartMaterialPaintingMode.SetHeightRangeName stores an edit.

label: Opacity mask path
summary: The file path of the opacity mask texture assigned to this smart brush entry.
details: Vanilla shows it as text and tooltip in the "Opacity Mask:" part, next to a button that clears the mask.

label: Height range visible
summary: Going by its name, whether this height range of the engine's smart brush is shown.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tools; vanilla never names it on this type. IsVisible on other types is only a hint.

label: Entry itself
summary: This smart brush entry itself, to hand to a function of the painting tool.
details: Vanilla passes it to many SmartMaterialPaintingMode functions: whether the entry is visible or debugged, its name, its opacity mask offset, scale and rotation, and its pattern mode. The game documents no return type.

label: Material mix
summary: Going by its name, the mix of terrain materials a smart brush pattern paints.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tools; vanilla never uses it. The game documents no return type.

label: Access brush pattern itself
summary: A function on a smart brush pattern that, going by its name, hands back the pattern itself.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tools; vanilla never names it on this type. PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents nothing more.

label: Angle L
summary: The smart brush pattern's "Angle L" setting, as a decimal number.
details: Vanilla shows it labelled "Angle L:" with minus and plus buttons (AddAngle); the tooltip calls it an angular range whose effect depends on the selected pattern. GetAngleR is the other end.

label: Angle R
summary: The smart brush pattern's "Angle R" setting, as a decimal number.
details: Vanilla shows it labelled "Angle R:" with minus and plus buttons (AddAngle); the tooltip calls it an angular range whose effect depends on the selected pattern. GetAngleL is the other end.

label: Bleeding
summary: The smart brush pattern's bleeding, the range in heightmap pixels over which patterns are averaged.
details: Vanilla shows it labelled "Bleeding:" with minus and plus buttons; its tooltip says smaller values give sharp results and bigger ones blurry results.

label: Density
summary: The smart brush pattern's density, how many rays it uses to analyse the ground around a point.
details: Vanilla shows it labelled "Density:" with minus and plus buttons; its tooltip says more rays give better precision but slower painting.

label: Interpolation choice
summary: Which interpolation the smart brush pattern uses, as the chosen entry of a drop-down.
details: Vanilla gives it as the selected entry of the drop-down filled from the interpolation names (GetSmartBrushInterpolationNames); changing it calls SetInterpolationIndex. It returns a pair of whole numbers, not documented further.

label: Opacity method
summary: The number of the method the smart brush pattern uses to work out opacity.
details: Vanilla's four option buttons check it: 0 is "By Average", 1 "By Average Min", 2 "By Average Max" and 3 "By Nearest Distance"; SetPatternMode changes it.

label: Pattern type choice
summary: Which pattern type the smart brush pattern uses, as the chosen entry of a drop-down.
details: Vanilla gives it as the selected entry of the drop-down filled from the pattern names (GetSmartBrushPatternNames); changing it calls SetPatternIndex. It returns a pair of whole numbers, not documented further.

label: Sharpness
summary: The smart brush pattern's sharpness, the range in which each detection point averages the ground's angles.
details: Vanilla shows it labelled "Sharpness:" with minus and plus buttons; its tooltip says smaller values give sharper average angles.

label: Pattern itself
summary: This smart brush pattern itself, to hand to an action of the painting tool.
details: Vanilla passes it to the SmartMaterialPaintingMode actions that change the pattern: its type, interpolation, angles, bleeding, sharpness and density. The game documents no return type.

label: Access brush presets
summary: Going by its name, the stored presets (saved settings) of the engine's smart brush.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tools; vanilla never uses it. Compare GetPresets on the same type. The game documents no return type.

label: Access preset manager itself
summary: A function on the smart brush preset manager that, going by its name, hands back the manager itself.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tools; vanilla never names it on this type. PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents nothing more.

label: Brush presets
summary: Going by its name, the list of smart brush presets.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tools; vanilla never uses it. How it differs from AccessPresets the game does not document.

label: Preset manager itself
summary: A function on the smart brush preset manager that, going by its name, hands back the manager itself.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tools; vanilla never names it on this type. Self after other types is only a hint. The game documents nothing more.

label: Access current preset
summary: Going by its name, the preset currently chosen in the engine's smart material painting tool.
details: The smart material painting mode belongs to the engine's internal tools (going by its name, painting terrain materials with rules). Vanilla never uses this function. The game documents no return type.

label: Current preset ranges
summary: Going by its name, the height ranges of the preset currently chosen in the smart material painting tool.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tools; vanilla never uses it. The game documents no return type.

label: Opacity mask preview
summary: A preview picture of the opacity mask texture of the smart brush entry given in brackets.
details: Vanilla shows it in the "Opacity Mask:" part when the entry has a mask texture, passing SmartBrushHeightRange.Self. The game documents no return type.

label: Pattern curve picture
summary: A picture of the curve of the smart brush pattern given in brackets.
details: Vanilla shows it next to the interpolation drop-down, passing the entry's pattern (SmartBrushHeightRange.AccessPattern.Self). The game documents no return type.

label: Pattern type picture
summary: A picture of the pattern type of the smart brush pattern given in brackets.
details: Vanilla shows it next to the pattern type drop-down, passing the entry's pattern (SmartBrushHeightRange.AccessPattern.Self). The game documents no return type.

label: Access painting mode itself
summary: A function on the smart material painting tool that, going by its name, hands back the tool itself.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tools; vanilla never names it on this type. PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents nothing more.

label: Change angle
summary: Changes one of a smart brush pattern's angles by an amount.
details: Vanilla's minus and plus buttons call it with the pattern, `yes` for Angle L or `no` for Angle R, and -1.0 or 1.0. Returns nothing.

fields.name: left
fields.text: Which angle: `yes` for Angle L, `no` for Angle R.

fields.name: amount
fields.text: How much to add; negative lowers it.

label: Change bleeding
summary: Changes a smart brush pattern's bleeding by an amount.
details: Vanilla's minus and plus buttons call it with the pattern and -1 or 1. Returns nothing.

fields.name: amount
fields.text: How much to add; negative lowers it.

label: Change density
summary: Changes a smart brush pattern's density by an amount.
details: Vanilla's minus and plus buttons call it with the pattern and -1 or 1. Returns nothing.

fields.name: amount
fields.text: How much to add; negative lowers it.

label: Shift opacity mask
summary: Moves the opacity mask of a smart brush entry by an amount, along X or Y.
details: Vanilla's minus and plus buttons call it with `yes` for Offset X or `no` for Offset Y, the entry, and -0.01 or 0.01. The tooltips give the offset's range as 0.0 to 1.0. Returns nothing.

fields.name: x
fields.text: Which offset: `yes` for X, `no` for Y.

fields.name: entry
fields.text: The smart brush entry whose mask moves.

fields.name: amount
fields.text: How much to add; negative moves it back.

label: Turn opacity mask
summary: Turns the opacity mask of a pattern entry in the smart material brush by the given number of degrees.
details: The smart material brush is a map editor tool of the game's engine that paints terrain materials by the shape of the ground. Vanilla uses it on the minus and plus buttons next to the "Rotation:" field of the opacity mask, with -1.0 and 1.0. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The pattern entry whose opacity mask is turned.
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush (vanilla passes SmartBrushHeightRange.Self)

fields.name: Arg1
fields.text: How much to turn it; negative turns it the other way.

label: Change opacity mask scale
summary: Changes the X or the Y scale of a pattern entry's opacity mask in the smart material brush by the given amount.
details: Vanilla uses it on the minus and plus buttons of the "Scale X:" and "Scale Y:" fields, with steps of 0.01. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Which axis: `yes` for X, `no` for Y.

fields.name: Arg1
fields.text: The pattern entry whose mask is scaled.
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush

fields.name: Arg2
fields.text: How much to add; negative makes it smaller.

label: Change sharpness
summary: Raises or lowers the sharpness of a pattern in the smart material brush by the given whole number.
details: Sharpness is the range in which each point that reads the ground shape averages its angles; smaller gives sharper angles (the editor's own tooltip). Vanilla uses it on the minus and plus buttons of the "Sharpness:" field. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a pattern of the brush (vanilla passes SmartBrushPattern.Self)

fields.name: Arg1
fields.text: How much to add; negative lowers it.

label: Apply changes
summary: Applies the materials shown in the smart material brush's preview mask to the map and clears the mask.
details: Vanilla uses it on the brush's "Apply Changes" button; the button is only active while CanApplyChanges is true. The brush paints into a preview first, so nothing changes on the map until this is called. It returns nothing.

label: Can apply changes
summary: Whether the smart material brush has a preview that can be applied or discarded now.
details: Vanilla uses it to switch on both the "Apply Changes" and the "Discard Changes" button of the brush.

label: Can move entry down
summary: Whether the given pattern entry of the smart material brush can move one place down in the list.
details: Vanilla uses it to switch on the button "Move this pattern entry Down".

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush

label: Can move entry up
summary: Whether the given pattern entry of the smart material brush can move one place up in the list.
details: Vanilla uses it to switch on the button "Move this pattern entry Up".

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush

label: Set material share
summary: Sets the share of one material in a pattern's material mix of the smart material brush to the value typed in.
details: Vanilla calls it when typing in the number field next to a material of the "Material Mix" is finished; the field is off while the material's share is locked. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg1
fields.text: The material entry in the mix.

fields.name: Arg2
fields.text: The pattern entry the mix belongs to.
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush

label: Clear opacity mask
summary: Removes the texture assigned as opacity mask from a pattern entry of the smart material brush.
details: Vanilla uses it on the "X" button with the tooltip "Clear assigned texture mask", active only while the entry has a mask. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The pattern entry whose mask is cleared.
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush

label: Clone preset
summary: Makes a copy of the current preset of the smart material brush.
details: Vanilla uses it on the "Clone" button of the brush's "Preset:" row, active only while the current preset is valid. It returns nothing.

label: Copy curve
summary: Copies a curve of the smart material brush to the brush's own clipboard, to paste it on another curve.
details: This clipboard is separate from the system clipboard. Vanilla uses it on the "Copy" button of the curve editor; the "Paste" button reads it back with GetCurveFromClipboard. It returns nothing.

label: New preset
summary: Creates a new preset in the smart material brush.
details: A preset is a saved set of patterns for the brush. Vanilla uses it on the "New" button of the "Preset:" row. It returns nothing.

label: Add pattern
summary: Adds a new pattern entry to the current preset of the smart material brush.
details: Vanilla uses it on the "Add new pattern" button, active only while the current preset is valid. The engine calls these entries height ranges in its function names. It returns nothing.

label: Delete preset
summary: Deletes the current preset of the smart material brush.
details: Vanilla uses it on the "Delete" button of the "Preset:" row, active only while the current preset is valid. It returns nothing.

label: Delete pattern entry
summary: Deletes the given pattern entry from the smart material brush's current preset.
details: Vanilla uses it on the button "Delete this pattern entry". It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush (vanilla passes SmartBrushHeightRange.AccessSelf)

label: Discard changes
summary: Throws away the smart material brush's preview mask without applying it to the map.
details: Vanilla uses it on the "Discard Changes" button, active only while CanApplyChanges is true. It returns nothing.

label: Finish material share edit
summary: Finishes a change of material shares made with a slider of the smart material brush's material mix.
details: Vanilla calls it when dragging the slider next to a material ends; StartSampleCompositionEdit is called when the drag starts. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg1
fields.text: The pattern entry the mix belongs to.
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush

label: Background work text
summary: A text about the work the smart material brush is doing in the background.
details: Vanilla shows it as the tooltip of the brush's progress spinner, which is visible only while IsBackgroundProcessing is true. What the text says is not shown in the game files.

label: Current preset
summary: The preset currently chosen in the smart material brush.
details: Vanilla only passes it on to other functions of the brush: to finish a material share edit, to lock a material's share and to set a share. Its type is not registered for scripts, so it cannot be read further.

label: Copied curve
summary: The curve last copied to the smart material brush's own clipboard.
details: Vanilla's "Paste" button of the curve editor sets a curve to it; CopyCurveToClipboard puts a curve there.

label: Debug text
summary: The text of the smart material brush's visual debugging tooltip.
details: Vanilla shows it under the heading "Debug:" in a tooltip that follows the mouse over the map, shown while IsVisualDebuggingTooltipActive is true. What it says is not shown in the game files.

label: Debug hint
summary: A second line of text in the smart material brush's visual debugging tooltip.
details: Vanilla shows it below GetDebugDesc in the "Debug:" tooltip over the map. Going by its name it is a usage hint; the game files do not show its text.

label: Opacity mask offset
summary: The X or the Y offset of a pattern entry's opacity mask in the smart material brush, a decimal number from 0.0 to 1.0.
details: Vanilla shows it in the "Offset X:" and "Offset Y:" fields; typing there calls SetOpacityMaskOffsetAsString.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Which axis: `yes` for X, `no` for Y.

fields.name: Arg1
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush

label: Opacity mask rotation
summary: How far a pattern entry's opacity mask is turned in the smart material brush, as a decimal number.
details: Vanilla shows it in the "Rotation:" field; the plus and minus buttons change it by 1.0 with AddOpacityMaskRotation.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush

label: Opacity mask scale
summary: The X or the Y scale of a pattern entry's opacity mask in the smart material brush, as a decimal number.
details: Vanilla shows it in the "Scale X:" and "Scale Y:" fields.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Which axis: `yes` for X, `no` for Y.

fields.name: Arg1
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush

label: Why painting is blocked
summary: A text the smart material brush shows over the map when painting is not allowed.
details: Vanilla shows it in a tooltip that follows the mouse, while IsPaintingForbiddenTooltipActive is true. Going by its name it says why painting is blocked; the game files do not show the text.

label: Chosen preset
summary: Which entry of the smart material brush's preset dropdown is chosen.
details: Vanilla uses it as the selected entry of the "Preset:" dropdown. It comes as a pair of whole numbers; what the two numbers mean is not documented.

label: Range name
summary: Going by its name, the name of the given range in the smart material painting tool, as text.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tools; vanilla never uses it.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Not documented; going by its name, which range.

label: Topology picker text
summary: The text of the tooltip the smart material brush shows over the map while picking the ground's shape.
details: Vanilla shows it under the heading "Topology Picker:" in a tooltip that follows the mouse, while IsTopologyPickerTooltipActive is true. The topology picker is the mode the button "Toggle terrain topology picker mode" turns on.

label: Has presets
summary: Going by its name, whether the smart material painting tool has any presets at all.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tools; vanilla never uses it.

label: Presets changed
summary: Whether the presets or patterns of the smart material brush have changes that are not saved yet.
details: Vanilla uses it to switch on the button "Save all presets and patterns".

label: Has opacity mask
summary: Whether a texture is assigned as opacity mask to the given pattern entry of the smart material brush.
details: Vanilla uses it to show the mask's preview picture and to switch on the button that clears the mask.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush

label: Autosave on
summary: Whether the smart material brush saves all changes to its presets and patterns by itself when the map editor closes.
details: Vanilla shows it as the tick of the "Autosave" checkbox; ToggleAutosave switches it.

label: Working in background
summary: Whether the smart material brush is busy with work in the background.
details: Vanilla shows the brush's progress spinner while this is true, with GetBackgroundProcessingDesc as its tooltip.

label: Preset is valid
summary: Whether the smart material brush has a valid current preset to work on.
details: Vanilla uses it to switch on the "Rename", "Clone" and "Delete" preset buttons and the "Add new pattern" button.

label: Curve clipboard empty
summary: Going by its name, whether no curve has been copied to the smart material brush's own clipboard.
details: Vanilla uses it to switch on the "Paste" button of the curve editor, which would make more sense if it were true when a curve is there. The name and the use disagree, so which way round it works is not certain.

label: Debug active
summary: Going by its name, whether the debug view of the smart material painting tool is on.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tools; vanilla never uses it. IsDebugActiveFor checks a single item.

label: Debugging shown for entry
summary: Whether visual debugging is switched on for the given pattern entry of the smart material brush.
details: Vanilla shows it as the state of the button "Toggle visual debugging of this pattern"; ToggleDebugActiveFor switches it.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush

label: Debug tooltip shown
summary: Going by its name, whether the debug tooltip of the smart material painting tool is shown.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tools; vanilla never uses it.

label: Debugging one point
summary: Going by its name, whether the smart material painting tool's debug view is looking at a single point of the map.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tools; vanilla never uses it.

label: Eraser chosen
summary: Whether the eraser, which erases the painted mask, is the chosen tool of the smart material brush.
details: Vanilla shows it as the state of the eraser button.

label: Eye dropper chosen
summary: Whether the eye dropper is the chosen tool of the smart material brush.
details: Vanilla shows it as the state of the brush's eye dropper button. What the eye dropper picks up is not described in the brush's file.

label: Pattern entry shown
summary: Whether the given pattern entry of the smart material brush is switched visible.
details: Vanilla shows it as the state of the button "Toggle visibility of this pattern".

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush

label: Opacity mask loading
summary: Whether the opacity mask texture of the given pattern entry is still loading.
details: Vanilla shows a marker over the mask's preview picture while this is true.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush

label: Painter chosen
summary: Whether the painter, which paints the preview mask, is the chosen tool of the smart material brush.
details: With the painter, materials are applied for now by the selected pattern and kept only with "Apply". Vanilla shows it as the state of the painter button.

label: Painting blocked
summary: Going by its name, whether painting is not allowed right now in the smart material painting tool.
details: It belongs to the engine's internal tools; vanilla never uses it. GetPaintingForbiddenDesc gives the reason as text.

label: Blocked tooltip shown
summary: Whether the smart material brush shows its tooltip about painting not being allowed.
details: Vanilla uses it to show the tooltip with GetPaintingForbiddenDesc that follows the mouse over the map.

label: Smart brush chosen
summary: Whether the smart material brush is the chosen tool of the map editor.
details: Vanilla shows it as the state of the "Smart Material Brush" button in the editor's toolbox.

label: Topology picker on
summary: Whether the smart material brush's terrain topology picker mode is switched on.
details: Vanilla shows it as the state of the button "Toggle terrain topology picker mode"; ToggleTopologyPicker switches it.

label: Topology tooltip shown
summary: Whether the smart material brush shows its topology picker tooltip over the map.
details: Vanilla uses it to show the "Topology Picker:" tooltip with GetTopologyPickerDesc.

label: Debug tooltip shown
summary: Whether the smart material brush shows its visual debugging tooltip over the map.
details: Vanilla uses it to show the "Debug:" tooltip with GetDebugDesc and GetDebugUIHint.

label: Reload presets
summary: Loads all presets and patterns of the smart material brush again.
details: The editor's tooltip says this can be undone. Vanilla uses it on the reload button next to the save button. It returns nothing.

label: Remove material
summary: Removes a material from a pattern's material mix in the smart material brush.
details: Vanilla uses it on the button "Remove this material from the mix". It returns nothing.

label: Rename preset
summary: Renames the current preset of the smart material brush.
details: Vanilla uses it on the "Rename" button of the "Preset:" row, active only while the current preset is valid. It takes no new name; how the name is entered is not shown in the game files. It returns nothing.

label: Move entry down
summary: Moves the given pattern entry of the smart material brush one place down in the list.
details: Vanilla uses it on the button "Move this pattern entry Down", active while CanReorderRangeToNext is true. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a pattern entry of the brush
